item.title: README: replace the Buy Me a Coffee badge with the Leetchi pot
item.body:
## Issue
Direct-PR: one-line README change requested by the operator (2026-11-07).
Claim: ext/francoisgn-suborch-1

## What and why
- The project's donation pot is now a Leetchi pot.
- The README "Support" section therefore points to it: `https://www.leetchi.com/fr/c/hfr-app-ios-o-9067155`. This replaces the Buy Me a Coffee badge.
- The `utm_*` tracking parameters of the shared link were dropped.
- The badge is a plain shields.io badge ("Leetchi · Cagnotte HFR App iOS"), with the same `for-the-badge` style as before.
- Leetchi has no shields.io logo, so the badge has none.

## How it was verified
The diff is one line in `README.md`. A `grep -i coffee` over the tracked Markdown files finds no other mention.

## Checklist (AGENTS.md §9)
- [x] Module boundaries respected (docs only)
- [x] Tests added/updated: n/a
- [x] No secrets; fixtures anonymized
- [x] Docs updated: README only
- [ ] Author model: Opus 5.5 / Reviewer model: any other model or a human (one-line docs change)
- [x] Fixes or changes a legacy-app behaviour? No
